review_remediation.worker_shutdown: The final application owner revokes publication under the commit mutex and disconnects admission. It retains the worker JoinHandle and waits up to 250 ms for exit, joining if finished. A still-blocked provider worker is detached only after fencing; it cannot publish old state or enter a later synthesis phase. This is not forcible cancellation of external inference.
review_remediation.validation_network: Cargo checks, tests and release build used --offline; formatting performs no dependency resolution. HTTP tests used only private ephemeral loopback fixtures. No production provider, real manager, container or host installation effects.

contract_notes_for_parent.wire: Frozen request, reply and operation result fields retained; no production endpoint environment override
contract_notes_for_parent.retention: 32 retained jobs plus 1024 durable expired-ID tombstones. Eviction applies only to terminal jobs. Expired IDs return REQUEST_EXPIRED and cannot be admitted again. New work returns CAPACITY once durable expiry metadata is full; no automatic reset/maintenance API was added.
contract_notes_for_parent.audio_after_restart: Completed submit text survives with audio null and speech_error AUDIO_EXPIRED. Completed speak retains succeeded metadata but result null and error AUDIO_EXPIRED; deliberate replay requires a new request ID.
contract_notes_for_parent.state_file: Separate 0600 app-state.json, bounded to 16 MiB including JSON escaping and retained terminal results. Debug state.json is not reinterpreted.
contract_notes_for_parent.provider_budgets: Overall inventory 10 seconds, STT 90, generation 120 including tag revalidation, synthesis 60 including voice revalidation; 2-second connect and bounded response bodies. Timeout does not guarantee external inference stopped.
